description: This file is a controller class for managing product options in the Opencart admin panel. It handles listing, creating, editing, deleting, and autocompleting options, and manages the associated views, models, and user permissions.

classes.name: Option
classes.description: Controller class for handling product option management within the Opencart admin interface.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main entry to display the options list page, loading header, footer, and content views.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Triggers loading the list of options.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Retrieves and renders the list of options with sorting, pagination, and filtering.

methods.name: form
methods.description: Displays the form for creating or editing an option, preloading existing data if editing.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving a new or edited option, validating permissions and data.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes selected options after permission checks and ensuring they are not linked to products.

methods.name: autocomplete
methods.description: Provides an autocomplete response for options, including their types and associated values.
